name: separator
useFor: Use between groups: under a page head, above the rail's footer, between list rows, between toolbar groups (orientation="vertical"). It is decorative unless you set decorative={false}.
constraints: Darker rules than the faint lilac between rows
source: Figma 427:2715: the rail's footer rule, page head rules, inbox list dividers
title: Separator
description: A 1px rule in the faint lilac, across or down.
